title: [CQ-V04b] Runner focused check dispatch client
definitionOfDone: Each check the daemon says the task owes is dispatched with its frozen definition (checkId, command and approved protected entries), in an environment listed in settings.checkEnvironments, and observed exactly once over /runner. An unlisted environment or a daemon refusal dispatches nothing further for that check.
A check job that exits 0 but changes any materialized snapshot file is recorded as 'inconclusive', never 'passed'.
The VM is deleted on every path (refusal, disconnect, timeout, crash), and the runner key never appears in output or logs.
Fresh verification `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-dispatch.test.mjs` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

amendments.reason: CQ-V05b (task-66e8d7d1) returns the bounded-repair decision on record_check_observation as a `repair` field. Its retry-infra action is the runner's cue to re-dispatch the same candidate's check. This adds test case Y for that loop and its local cap. Every other case is unchanged.

implementationPlan.description:
Create scripts/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs: pure coordination, with every dependency injected and Node stdlib only. Budget about 150 lines. The header comment states:
- it publishes evidence only through the injected /runner channel, and 'passed' only after the post-run integrity report;
- it never claims isolation and never enables verified-local.

Exports:
1. owedChecks(context): mirrors CQ-V04's delivery/policy.ts owedChecks exactly, as tested in O. The daemon's dispatch admission (CHECK_DEFINITION_NOT_APPROVED) is the backstop, so a mirror drift fails closed.
2. dispatchFocusedChecks({ taskId, snapshot, call, runCheck, signal }), in this order:
   - context = await call('moe.get_context', { taskId }), then the binding checks (B).
   - For each owed check, sequentially:
     - run runCheck({ snapshot, check: { id, command, protected }, signal, onReady }).
     - onReady(environment) throws RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_APPROVED unless settings.checkEnvironments includes the environment. Otherwise it calls record_check_dispatch with a fresh 'dispatch-<32 hex>' id, retrying only a transport failure with the same id.
     - After the run, outcome = (result.outcome === 'passed' && result.workspace !== 'intact') ? 'inconclusive' : result.outcome.
     - Call record_check_observation with a fresh 'check-<32 hex>' id and the dispatch's environment, retrying only RUNNER_DISCONNECTED or RUNNER_CALL_TIMEOUT with the same id, up to 3 attempts.
   - It stops at the first refusal or failure, with one fixed RUNNER_* code, plus the daemon codeName when there is one.
   - It resolves a frozen summary {taskId, candidateId, results: [{checkId?, command, dispatchId, outcome}], stopped?: {code, codeName?, dispatchId?}}.
   - Ids come from crypto.randomBytes(16).

Error handling: every thrown error carries `code`. A runCheck rejection stops the run with RUNNER_CHECK_FAILED, and no observation is invented for it. The seam contract says runCheck deletes its VM before it settles; the coordinator never starts another check after a stop.

   - It resolves a frozen summary {taskId, candidateId, results: [{checkId?, command, dispatchId, outcome}], stopped?: {code, codeName?, dispatchId?}}. results holds one entry per run, so a re-run adds its own entry.

amendments.reason: CQ-V05b (task-66e8d7d1) returns the bounded-repair decision on the record_check_observation result. A retry-infra decision must re-dispatch the same candidate's check through V04's dispatch path, bounded locally at 10 re-runs per check. This matches V05's maxInfraRetries cap of 10, so the daemon stays the budget authority. Everything else is unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: Owed checks and the frozen frame (id, command, protected entries) equal the get_context approved snapshot and gate rules. An unapproved revision or a snapshot/tree mismatch dispatches nothing.

Every dispatch carries the exact V03 params and an environment from settings.checkEnvironments, and is observed exactly once. An unlisted environment or a daemon refusal stops the run with no further dispatch.
passed with a workspace that is not intact is observed 'inconclusive'.
Every VM create has exactly one delete on every path, and the CLI never prints a raw error message or the key.
invariants: Definitions come only from the daemon's approved snapshot, never from candidate bytes.
At most one VM at a time; none survives a stop.
Retries reuse the same dispatch id or check id; nothing mints a second record.
No Git writes, no .moe edits, no non-loopback network, and verified-local untouched.
compatibility: CQ-V03's tool params and CQ-V03b's replay rules are used unchanged.
cli.mjs and the R-series modules are not edited; the orchestrator is reached only through the adapter.
approvedScope: New scripts/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs: owedChecks, dispatchFocusedChecks and the CLI entry.
reuse: openRunnerChannel (V04b1, scripts/local-runner/runner-client.mjs) is the only key and transport code.
exportSourceSnapshot (scripts/local-runner/source-export.mjs) produces the candidate snapshot from the wrapper's frozen commit.
R11 final's orchestrator, which already composes provisionGuest, waitForGuestReady, materializeSnapshot, runCheckSession, checkEnvironment and VM deletion; it is bound, never re-implemented.
The cli.mjs argument and entry-guard style.
sourceAssumptions: scripts/local-runner/source-export.mjs: exportSourceSnapshot({repoDir, commit, git?, timeoutMs?}) resolves a frozen SourceSnapshot {version: 1, commit, tree, base, overlay, excluded}.

packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContext.ts serves task.executionContract, task.requiredCheckSnapshot (only when bound to the current definitions), task.isEpicFinal, currentCandidate, servedContext.planRevision and approvedPlanRevision, and project.settings.

ASSUMED, V04b1 (planned with this task): openRunnerChannel({projectPath, timeoutMs, signal}) gives {call(tool, args, {signal}), close()}. Errors carry a fixed RUNNER_* code; RUNNER_TOOL_ERROR carries the daemon's codeName.

ASSUMED, R11 final seam (requested in comment-9694da9c on task-07951125): runCheck({snapshot, check: {id, command, protected}, onReady, signal}) gives {outcome, exitCode, outputTail, environment, workspace: 'intact'|'changed'|'unverified'}. It awaits onReady(environment) before the job, deletes the VM if onReady throws and rejects with that error, and deletes the VM before settling on every path.

ASSUMED, CQ-V03: record_check_dispatch {id?, taskId, candidateId, planRevision, command, checkId?, environment} and record_check_observation {id, dispatchId, exitCode, outcome, outputTail?, environment}. ASSUMED, CQ-V04: admission refusals CHECK_DEFINITION_NOT_APPROVED and CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_APPROVED.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. Owed-check source: a new daemon read tool versus get_context. CHOSEN: get_context, which needs no daemon slice. The rule is mirrored, with V04's admission as the backstop, so drift fails closed. The wrapper already mirrors requiredCheckCommand the same way.
2. The runner channel client was split into V04b1 (task-18b365e5) for QA's 400-net cap. It is the only key-touching code.
3. Orchestrator coupling. R11 final is unplanned, so runCheck is an injected seam whose contract this task defines (consumer-driven); the comment on task-07951125 asks R11 final to honour it. The CLI adapter fails closed with RUNNER_SEAM_UNAVAILABLE when a seam is missing.
4. Sequential versus parallel checks: sequential. One VM at a time, which keeps resources bounded and cleanup simple.
5. Stop at the first refusal versus continuing: stop. VM provisioning is expensive, and refusals are usually systemic (candidate superseded, revision changed).
6. The CLI entry lives inside check-dispatch.mjs rather than as a cli.mjs subcommand, because CQ-R13 owns open cli.mjs fixes.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Node 24's global WebSocket sends custom headers (`new WebSocket(url, { headers })`); verified in this session.
- /runner speaks the same JSON-RPC as /mcp:
  - result: content[0].text is the tool result as JSON;
  - error: {code, message, data: {tool, codeName}}.
- R11a frame rules: id /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/; command 1-1000 characters with no control character; protected at most 2000 {path, 40-hex oid} entries. The gate has no checkId, so the frame uses 'quality-gate'.
- exportSourceSnapshot needs a COMMIT. The wrapper's FROZEN_COMMIT has the candidate's tree, so the activation caller passes it, and the coordinator checks snapshot.tree === currentCandidate.treeSha.
- CQ-V03b replay rules: an identical dispatch or observation with the same id gives duplicate:true, which is why ids are caller-generated.
planningNotes.risks:
- The R11 final seam may land differently. Adapt only the adapter; if a seam is truly missing, the entry must refuse, never run without integrity.
- The owedChecks mirror can drift from V04's daemon function. Test O pins the rules, and admission refuses the rest.
- get_context without a workerId must be the untrimmed default view; verify it at WORKING time.
- Activation (the wrapper calling this entry per strong candidate) is out of scope and noted on V12.
- Multipass is not on PATH in WSL, so everything is fake-tested; no isolation claim is made.
